newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-BTP sees growth despite strong stg.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-BTP sees growth despite strong stg.

text.p: British chemicals group BTP Plc said on Tuesday it expected to maintain strong profit growth despite sterling's strength, which may hurt this year's earnings by over 5.0 million stg.

"We see sustained growth. The underlying growth of the divisions will provide the opportunities to continue to grow at the rate we have done," chief executive Steve Hannam told Reuters in an interview.
Hannam said he expected 1997/98's earnings to be boosted by its acquisition of fine chemicals maker PCR Inc, which should add 2.5-3.0 million stg to pretax profits in the first year of ownership.
Operating profits at BTP's biocides and fine chemicals division grew 8.5 percent to 28.6 million stg for the year.
"We will be looking for further bolt-on acquisitions in that area to increase our chemistry set," Hannam said.
The fine chemicals unit accounted for two-thirds of last year's 19.1 million stg capital spending budget.
Hannam said BTP planned to spend just over 20 million stg on capital investment projects this year.
